observation.command: TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST http://localhost/c/token -d 'grant_type=password&username=admin&password=Harbor12345' | tr -d '"' | sed 's/^[^=]*=//'); echo '--- systeminfo version field ---'; curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost/api/v2.0/systeminfo | tr ',' '\n' | grep -i version; echo '--- core container version ---'; docker exec harbor-local-core-1 cat /etc/harbor/harbor_version 2>/dev/null || docker exec harbor-local-core-1 cat /home/harbor/harbor_version 2>/dev/null || echo 'no version file found'
